svg.title: Architecture 4: Horizon Transformer-MoE
svg.desc: Horizon self-attention · Four learned experts with soft routing · 8 training epochs

g.text: Horizon self-attention · Four learned experts with soft routing · 8 training epochs
Each delivery token can attend to the origin state
The 41 tokens form one attention sequence
Self-attention calculation: Attention(Q, K, V) = Softmax(QK^T / √24) V
Full self-attention over the known input sequence
• Each of the 41 tokens can attend to every other token
• Delivery tokens have access to the origin token
• All input covariates must be available at the origin
Build the input to the mixture of experts
Drop the origin token after attention
2. Concatenate attention output and raw input:
Number of joint input channels: 96 + 50 = 146 dimensions
Combines attention context with raw features
• Input is shared by the router and all four experts
Routing is computed independently at each step
3. Soft routing and mixture of experts
• Softmax weights sum to one at each delivery step
• All experts contribute through learned weights
Four experts with the same architecture
Structure: LayerNorm(146) → Linear(146→96) → SiLU → Dropout → Linear(96→96)
Weighted mixture with attention skip connection
Add the weighted expert outputs to the attention output
Ordered by construction: q_05 ≤ … ≤ q_50 ≤ … ≤ q_95
Quantile loss: 0.45 × grid pinball + 0.35 × MAE + 0.20 × tail pinball
Inference averages the classifier and quantile CDF estimates
Shapes: tokens [B,41,96] → attention [B,40,96] → weights [B,40,4] and expert outputs [B,40,4,96] → mixture [B,40,96] → output heads
